decision_conditions: Carbon Offset contribution payments remains outstanding (£217,121 plus indexation) and to be paid as per the DoV agreement.

Please be advised that the details hereby approved only permits the partial discharge of Condition 37 (Carbon Reduction Measures - Block C Only) as attached to planning permission ref. 1331/APP/2019/2314. Therefore further details are required to be submitted and approved in order to fully discharge this condition.
application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
description: Details pursuant to the partial discharge of Condition 37 (carbon reduction measures - Block C only) of planning permission ref. 1331/APP/2019/2314 dated 28-06-2021 (Development of 4 no. new buildings comprising residential units (in addition to those approved under planning permission ref: 1331/APP/2017/1883), a basement extension to Block B, flexible commercial uses (Class E) and associated landscaping, access, car parking and other engineering works).
